threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US naval blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS New Orleans was patrolling the Arabian Sea during a US blockade of Iranian ports, with 48 vessels redirected over 20 days, while Iran International reported Iranian lawmakers proposed barring Israeli ships and charging US allies tolls. Iran International also cited Bloomberg saying Iran is curbing oil production as exports plunge; Defa Press claimed the supertanker HUGE broke through with 1.9 million barrels and quoted John Bolton on Hormuz's strategic importance.

threads.label: Regime messaging on US economic costs of war
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press posted a series of items claiming the war against Iran is driving up US petrol, diesel and consumer prices, citing the Financial Times, Washington Post and Washington Times. IRIB also claimed Detroit automakers GM, Ford and Stellantis warned of a $5 billion cost shock, and that flags were burned in Los Angeles.

threads.label: Khamenei Labour and Teachers' Day messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released an audio message and accompanying texts for Labour Day and Teachers' Day on 11 Ordibehesht 1405, urging employers to avoid layoffs and praising teachers' role in shaping identity. IRIB and Defa Press carried gatherings in Shiraz, Islamshahr, Shahriar and at Shahid Raisi Square framed as renewing covenant with the "martyred leader".

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon front activity
threads.summary: The IDF posted video of an Israeli Air Force strike dismantling a loaded launcher in southern Lebanon. Defa Press claimed Israeli casualties in the north continue to rise after the ceasefire with Iran, and IRIB cited a "Credal" report claiming Israeli unemployment has passed 16%, the highest since the pandemic.

threads.label: Iranian operations and figures abroad
threads.summary: Iran International reported, citing Fox News, that Iran is accused of supplying attack drones used by Sudan's army as the civil war enters its fourth year, and that Canada's opposition is questioning how an IRGC-linked football official was admitted. A separate Iran International analysis examined the public rift in Tehran over who is making decisions.

Currently, many businesses are closed or semi-closed and economic activity in various sectors has sharply declined.

events.title_en: Launch of gold bar auction from today. A new session of gold bar auction at Iran's exchange centre will be held today, Sunday. Based on the new decision, platforms and online gold sellers will also have the opportunity to purchase gold bars at the exchange centre's auctions, provided they have a unique business licence ID enquirable from the national permits gateway. The amount of deposit required for participation in the auction has also changed, and according to the new notification, for the purchase of each 1-kilogram gold bar with 995 fineness, 5 billion tomans is set as the deposit.

events.title_en: Shock of increased costs for American car manufacturers. US car manufacturers in Detroit warned of severe consequences of the war against Iran. Car manufacturers announced: the war against Iran will cause a five billion dollar cost shock for goods. The three major American automakers, General Motors, Ford and Stellantis, stated: the war has strained supply chains for raw materials from aluminium to plastic and paint. These companies warned that due to increased commodity inflation, the costs of these companies have increased and consequently car prices in America will rise.

events.title_en: Financial Times: Among the Group of Seven countries, America has received the most severe oil shock from Trump's war against Iran. Petrol and diesel prices in America are rising faster than other economies such as the UK and Canada. The structural dependence of America's fuel market and the speed of transmission of price increases to consumers have made this country more vulnerable than other members of the Group of Seven to the economic consequences of war with Iran.

events.title_en: The most effective link in the cultural struggle. An overview of the unparalleled position and the special role and duty of teachers based on the message of His Eminence Seyyed Majataba Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Revolution. Key functions of the teacher: serious responsibility for teaching knowledge; fostering insight and shaping the identity of the future generation; developing skills; delineating Iranian Islamic identity and its increasing entrenchment in minds. Importance of teachers and teaching: the most effective link in the cultural struggle; the backbone of the cultural arena; students and scholars represent the conduct and words of their teachers. Recommendation to teachers: awareness of the importance of their special position beyond a profession. Taken from the message of 11 Ordibehesht 1405.

events.title_en: The blessed tree; the fruit of 37 years of leadership of the martyred Leader
events.summary_en: The blessed tree; the fruit of 37 years of leadership of the martyred Leader. When our martyred Leader took on the leadership, the Islamic Republic system was like a sapling that had received numerous wounds from the enemies of Islam and Iran, and of course had borne them all well. But when, after nearly 37 years, they left the seat of the leadership of the nation, they left behind a blessed tree whose roots are strong and whose branches overshadow important parts of the region and the world. A passage from the message of Ayatollah Seyyed Mostafa Khamenei, Leader of the Islamic Revolution, 20 Farvardin 1405
